resources.string: Give Orbit tasks from your own WhatsApp chat
Message yourself on WhatsApp to give Orbit a task
Link Orbit as a device on your WhatsApp to give it tasks from your own chat.
Message yourself on WhatsApp to give Orbit a task.
Orbit reconnects when the network is back.
Orbit is disconnected from WhatsApp and reads no new messages.
Orbit was removed from Linked devices. Link it again to keep using WhatsApp.
WhatsApp has blocked this linked device for now.
WhatsApp no longer accepts this version of Orbit’s connection. Update Orbit.
Couldn’t reach WhatsApp. Orbit keeps trying.
Send yourself a WhatsApp message that starts with “Orbit”, like “Orbit, book a table for two at 8”. Orbit does it on this phone and replies in the same chat.

Orbit links as a device using an unofficial WhatsApp client (whatsmeow). WhatsApp doesn’t allow unofficial clients, so your number could be banned. Orbit reads and messages only the chats you pick, and asks you on this phone before it sends each message.
Your WhatsApp number, with country code
In WhatsApp, open Settings › Linked devices › Link a device, tap “Link with phone number instead”, and type this code. WhatsApp may also show a notification asking for it.
On the phone with your WhatsApp, open Settings › Linked devices › Link a device and scan this code.
Couldn’t start linking. Check the number and your connection, then try again.
None yet. Orbit can’t read or message any chat until you pick one.
No chats found yet. WhatsApp may still be syncing your contacts; try again in a minute.
When off, Orbit disconnects from WhatsApp
Keeps your notes to yourself from starting tasks
Allow WhatsApp tasks to wake and unlock
Only tasks from your own chat can try to wake and unlock this phone.

Off by default; linking another account turns it off. First turn on “%3$s” in “%1$s › %2$s” and save your lock-screen PIN or password there, if you use one. This switch doesn’t change that permission or use anything sent through WhatsApp.

The WhatsApp task couldn’t wake or unlock the phone. Unlock it yourself, or check wake and unlock permission in Orbit’s WhatsApp settings, plus remote unlock permission and saved credentials in Settings › Connect a computer.
Orbit leaves your Linked devices, deletes the session, your chat choices and the messages it kept from this phone, and turns off unlocking for WhatsApp tasks.
The change couldn’t be saved. Try again.
Saved %1$s on your phone. Open Orbit to see it.
The WhatsApp session is stored only on this phone and left out of backups. Orbit keeps the last 50 messages of each chat you pick, on this phone, so it can read them; other chats are never stored.
